name: codex-twin-agents
description: Fork same-context Codex twins for asynchronous open-ended review, cleanup, verification, and follow-up.

interface.longDescription: Create same-context Codex twins that continue from the parent's full or maximum available context and asynchronously inspect unfinished, unverified, inconsistent, or improvable work. Twins can complete already-authorized low-risk cleanup and report higher-impact findings back to the parent with evidence.
